mapper.sql: c.id AS customer_id, c.code, c.name, c.level, c.contact, c.phone, c.address, c.credit_limit, c.payment_days, c.status, x.id, x.owner_id, x.dept_id, x.industry, x.source, COALESCE(x.stage, 'POTENTIAL') AS stage, x.region, x.website, x.last_follow_time, x.next_follow_time, x.claim_time, COALESCE(x.create_time, c.create_time) AS create_time, x.update_time, u.nickname AS owner_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_contact ct WHERE ct.customer_id = c.id) AS contact_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_opportunity o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.stage NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST')) AS open_opp_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) FROM crm_opportunity o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.stage NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST')) AS open_opp_amount

sql.if: AND (c.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.contact LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM crm_customer x JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = x.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = x.owner_id WHERE x.owner_id IS NOT NULL AND x.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND x.next_follow_time <= #{dueBefore}
ORDER BY x.next_follow_time, x.last_follow_time DESC, c.code

SELECT FROM scm_customer c LEFT JOIN crm_customer x ON x.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = x.owner_id WHERE c.status = 1 AND x.owner_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.code
SELECT FROM scm_customer c LEFT JOIN crm_customer x ON x.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = x.owner_id WHERE c.id = #{customerId}

SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN d.total_amount ELSE -d.total_amount END), 0) FROM scm_trade_doc d WHERE d.partner_id = #{customerId} AND d.kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND d.biz_date >= #{since}) AS "salesAmount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_order o WHERE o.kind = 'SALES' AND o.partner_id = #{customerId} AND o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL', 'COMPLETED')) AS "orderCount", (SELECT CAST(MAX(o.order_date) AS CHAR(10)) FROM scm_order o WHERE o.kind = 'SALES' AND o.partner_id = #{customerId} AND o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL', 'COMPLETED')) AS "lastOrderDate", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.amount - b.settled_amount), 0) FROM fin_bill b WHERE b.kind = 'AR' AND b.partner_id = #{customerId}) AS "arBalance", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_opportunity o WHERE o.customer_id = #{customerId} AND o.stage = 'WON') AS "wonCount", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) FROM crm_opportunity o WHERE o.customer_id = #{customerId} AND o.stage = 'WON') AS "wonAmount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_ticket t WHERE t.customer_id = #{customerId} AND t.status IN ('OPEN', 'PROCESSING')) AS "openTickets"
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_customer SET owner_id = #{ownerId}, dept_id = #{deptId}, claim_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND owner_id IS NULL
